Rules:
White($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: White things are cold.
Blue($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: If something is blue then it is white.
Cold($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: If something is cold then it is round.
Green($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: If something is green then it is quiet.
Round($x, True) && Big($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: All round, big things are green.
Round(Bob, True) >>> Big(Bob, True) ::: If Bob is round then Bob is big.
White($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: All white, quiet things are big.
Big($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If something is big then it is cold.
Blue($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If something is blue and quiet then it is cold.

Query:
Green(Bob, False) ::: Bob is not green.
